code:
L_CLIP(theta) = E[ min(
    r_t(theta) * A_t,
    clip(r_t(theta), 1-eps, 1+eps) * A_t
) ]                                    # typical eps = 0.2
caption: min() always picks the more pessimistic estimate — never rewards over-updating
